race.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
race.verdict: WELLWHATSHAPPENIN has made a positive start for current connections and ran well when second at Chelmsford 17 days ago, so he's taken to build on that effort here. Poke The Bear has bagged 3 wins at this track and is now 3 lb below his last winning mark so looks the biggest danger. Electric Bass is one of several others with place claims. WELLWHATSHAPPENIN (IRE) POKE THE BEAR (IRE) ELECTRIC BASS
